cross_verification.note: St. Kitts and Nevis is visa-free for the large majority of nationalities. The High Commission in London's official 'Visa & Immigration' page (stkittsnevishcuk.gov.kn) states only that 'Two (2) recent colour passport sized photos' are required, with no further composition detail (exact mm, background colour, head-height ratio, expression/glasses/headwear rules). The detailed composition standard (45×35mm, plain white background, 70-80% face ratio, no glasses, headwear exceptions, etc.) is officially published only for the ePassport application — see kn-passport.json — and was not found duplicated in an explicit visa-specific document, so per the truthfulness gate it is not carried over here without direct confirmation.
